capabilities: : Paint cells with colors and opacities
extras: Full documentation available at alas-poor-ophelia.github.io/windrose-md. Map data is stored in JSON files within the vault.
intentEvidence: A TTRPG mapping tool that lives in your Obsidian notes.
motivation: I just liked the name. Feel free to call it just "Map Designer" — above all I want this tool to be useful.
problem: The difficulty of keeping complex, visual world and dungeon maps synchronized with the corresponding narrative notes in a text-based editor.

relations.evidence: Windrose started life as a Datacore compiled script
Wall and path tiles from Dungeondraft packs are detected and handled automatically

summary: A TTRPG mapping tool that allows users to draw and manage complex dungeon and world maps directly within Obsidian notes using grid or hex systems.
